$comment: Who owns each asset of krizaka.com and where it comes from (krizaka-internal#4482): read by scripts/assets-registry.mjs, which writes lib/assets.json (the registry checked by the org's assets-guard). The first rule whose `match` is the file (an exact path) or a folder of it (ending in /) wins; a CDN file is matched by its logical path (lib/cdn-manifest.json), a committed file by its repository path. A file no rule matches fails the build of the registry: its owner and origin are decided here, never guessed. `origin` is a closed set: test (a recording or a portrait of the dev data), design (a deliverable: drawn, rendered or generated), founder (a file the founder supplied). `pages` are the sources of this repository that name the files, the address of the other site that uses them, or « TO VALIDATE: … » when no source of this repository names them (the owner decides: keep them for another site, or prune). Under home/showcase/, the storyboard (content/films/home-showcase.json) refines `origin`: a shot cut from a founder's reel is « founder », a clip or a film is « design ».
